decisions.reason: The candidate's message-39 INTRODUCE already fully records the separate Wix website and Wix account architecture required by the payout-isolation mechanism.
The candidate already records isolated bookings, calendars, revenue, sales, and reporting, including a message-39 update for reporting; the payment setup itself belongs to the source Requirement.
The existing message-39 MODIFY already records selection on the master site and routing to each location's separate Wix website.
The message-39 Event already extends the Wix booking requirement to both Seattle and Bay Area; separate business-data ownership is represented by another atomic Requirement.
Using separate Wix accounts and payment setups does not change the confirmed Smash Room brand name or its branding scope.
The payout-isolation mechanism for operational locations does not alter the existing requirement to support integration of future locations.
The separate-site payment architecture does not change the visual-design reference, layout style, navigation style, or design origin.
Message 39 reiterates the existing master-site role but does not materially change its current requirement state.
The location payment-isolation mechanism does not logically change the existing goal of minimizing SEO damage during the Bay Area migration.
